selection_algorithm: 1. specials = all 7 early closes UNION all 7 net-manifest partial days UNION the 2022-03-10 integrity sentinel (14 distinct days)

2. required strata anchors = first dev day of 2025-02 (floor-qualified source), first dev day of 2026-04 and of 2026-05 (raw roster hole), first dev day of 2021-02 (block1/HF era), first dev day of 2025-03 (HF resumed era), first dev day of 2026-03 (Alpaca SIP era)
3. if union > 20: drop generic era anchors only, never an integrity/special day, in the declared anchor priority order (2026-03, 2025-03, 2021-02, 2026-05, 2026-04, 2025-02 excluded last)
4. if union < 20: fill with the first dev day of each remaining month in ascending month order
5. branch anchors replace the generic era anchors where a censor-coverage day exists (D11); target stays 20

raw lane source availability per month (2025-02 fallback; 2026-03..05 Alpaca SIP backfill)
